description.en: Handcrafted plugins for the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的插件。
输入框旁的增强按钮会把当前提示词增强成更完整、更准确的执行指令。读取工作区结构，把「那个项目」「这个文件」换成真实存在的名字，补齐交付物、落点、受众、硬约束、验收标准与范围，结果直接写回输入框并可一键撤销。维度表可在设置中自定义，或套用写作、代码、翻译、汇报等场景模板。
description.en: The enhance button beside the composer turns the current prompt into a more complete, more precise instruction. It reads the workspace so vague references become real names, fills in deliverable, destination, audience, constraints, acceptance, and scope, then writes the result back into the composer with one-step undo. Dimensions are editable in Settings or via scenario templates for writing, coding, translation, and reporting.
